Errors carry `code` `INVALID_REQUEST` or `INVALID_PLAYBACK_ID` (400), `ALBUM_NOT_FOUND` or `PLAYLIST_NOT_FOUND` (404), and `CACHE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (409) when the used bytes of every device plus the estimate exceed the limit.

get.description: Merges library artists, albums, tracks and podcasts, the user's liked streaming tracks and albums that are not in the library, playlists the user can see (their own and public ones), and catalog artists, tracks and podcasts, sorted by `score`. A catalog item that duplicates a library item is left out. `type` defaults to `all`, which ignores `offset`; another `type` returns only that kind and pages by `offset` (at most 1000). `limit` defaults to 30 (1 to 100). A blank `q` returns no items. A disabled or failing catalog degrades to the other sources. Results are cached per user for 2 minutes. 400 for a missing `q`, a `q` over 500 characters, an unknown `type`, or a `limit` or `offset` out of range.
